grh_b3bca520b7a56c8ef484.title: Fields Of Corn
paragraphs: World War I veteran Jim Brown is terrified that his only son Howard will volunteer for the Air Corps and endure the horrors that killed Jim's friends and left him with years of nightmares. He even offers Dr. Christian a thousand dollars to declare the healthy young man medically unfit, but the doctor refuses. Howard agrees to stay on the farm for his father's sake, despite wanting to serve and despite the support of the girl he plans to marry. During a violent night storm, Jim is shaken by what he describes as a dream or vision in which the corn outside seems to become the comrades who died beside him in the last war, calling on him not to make their sacrifice meaningless. By morning Jim has changed his mind and gives Howard his blessing to do what he believes is his duty.

paragraphs: After cheating an Australian bushman out of a valuable diamond and killing him, Alec Riverton returns home haunted by the dead man’s warning that he will die on the third day. grh_b304c2941e290bfa61f9.title: Little Sweetheart
paragraphs: Polly Palmer returns to Rivers End and throws herself into raising money for Dr. Christian's children's clinic, rekindling the childhood hero-worship she has felt for him all her life. She breaks her engagement to Lee Morgan and mistakes Dr. Christian's gratitude and affection for romantic love, leaving the embarrassed doctor afraid that correcting her will humiliate her. Lee follows her home but, instead of forcing the issue, helps make the hospital campaign a success.
